nav.label: Main navigation
header.break_glass: You are signed in as the local admin break-glass account; every action is audited.
caps.read_only: Read-only: feedback and reruns need the responder, approver or admin role
caps.no_approve: Approving needs the approver or admin role
login.title: Sign in to SreNautix
login.break_glass: Single sign-on is enabled; the local admin is a break-glass entry and every action is audited.
login.totp_off: TOTP is off: the local admin signs in with the password only. H-tier approvals still need re-authentication with password and TOTP.
settings.totp_off: Local admin sign-in does not require TOTP (identity.local_admin.totp_required=false); the password alone signs in. The configured TOTP secret is kept, and H-tier approvals still need re-authentication with password and TOTP. Changes to the switch are recorded in the audit chain (identity.local_admin_totp).
login.locked: Too many failures; the account is temporarily locked
login.none_because: The server has neither OIDC nor the local admin configured. Set identity.oidc or identity.localAdmin in the Helm values.
reauth.title: Re-authenticate
reauth.desc: Tier H approval requires re-authentication within the last 5 minutes.
actions.title: Action queue
actions.batch_rule: Batch approval only covers tier L proposals of the same action and cluster
actions.empty_because.pending: Neither research nor rules proposed an action that needs a human; auto-executed actions are not listed here.
actions.empty_because.running: No action is approved, waiting for the gateway, or executing.
actions.empty_because.history: No proposal has ended (rejected, expired, stale) yet.
raw.title: Raw prompts
raw.audited: Raw prompts are not redacted; this read was written to the governance audit chain.
raw.none_because: The worker stores redacted content only, or this research made no model call.
raw.forbidden_because: Raw prompts are visible to auditor and admin only.
run.add_eval_case_desc: Makes the incident of this run an eval candidate; an admin confirms its type, roots and disposition on the eval page before it is exported as a label.
eval.title: Replay and eval
eval.mode_note.snapshot: Snapshot replay reads only the query neighbourhood frozen when a case was promoted; release gates and published scores use it.
eval.mode_note.reconstructed: Reconstructed replay re-queries within retention; downsampled cards are marked reconstructed. It is a trend reference and never gates a release.
eval.empty.snapshot: No eval case has been promoted, or replay has not finished. Promote an incident from its research run page.
eval.empty.reconstructed: The first observe-mode scorecard appears within an hour of install, then again whenever routes, packs or the version change.
eval.not_found: The scorecard in the URL is not in this mode's list.
eval.no_rows: No route finished replay in this evaluation.
eval.gates_note: Parentheses show numerator/denominator; intervals are 90% cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals.
eval.benign_note: A benign case that forms no incident in reconstruction is silent: it counts as correct and is left out of disposition, coverage and undetermined. False pushes, issues and PRs are computed on benign cases only; silent runs count in the denominator.
eval.axes_note: Mechanism hits and evidence grounding count only cases whose truth has mechanism assertions or required evidence; abstaining runs and runs without a conclusion count as misses. Safety violations count completed and silent runs: act or a PR below likely, or act, any proposal or a PR on a benign case.
eval.environments_note: Each route has one row per environment fingerprint; scores with different fingerprints are not compared directly
eval.cand.title: Eval candidates
eval.cand.meta: Export confirmed candidates as labels with srenautix eval candidates export
eval.cand.empty.pending: Feedback reason codes, closed fix PRs, incident issues closed as not planned and Add to eval create candidates.
eval.cand.empty.confirmed: No candidate has been confirmed yet.
eval.cand.empty.dropped: No candidate has been dropped yet.
eval.cand.roots_hint: Component keys separated by commas, for example Deployment:shop/api
eval.cand.benign_note: Benign: no roots and the disposition is ignore; forming no incident, or an incident that is not pushed, is correct in reconstruction.
eval.cand.abstain_note: Abstain: the real cause is not in the observable data, so the correct conclusion is undetermined.
eval.no_gate: This evaluation was not compared to a baseline.
eval.paired_delta_v: One-sided 90% lower bound of new minus old: {low} points, threshold {th}
clusters.title: Clusters
clusters.empty_because: A single-cluster install embeds the reader in the server; a multi-cluster install deploys a reader and gateway per managed cluster, which appear here once they dial the hub.
search.title: Search: {q}
search.no_query: Type an incident label, component or proposal in the header search box.
search.empty: No incident label, root component, alert name or proposal matched.
search.empty_cluster: No matches in cluster {cluster}; switch to all clusters to widen the search.
alerts.title: Incident of an alert
alerts.failed: Failed to look up the alert's incident
alerts.no_labels_title: The link carries no alert labels
alerts.no_labels: An alert link writes each label as l.name=value and needs at least l.alertname.
alerts.outcome.not_grouped: This alert is not in an incident yet
alerts.outcome.not_visible: This alert is outside your read scope
alerts.outcome.self_alert: This is a SreNautix meta alert
alerts.outcome.ignored: This alert never joins an incident
alerts.because.not_received: SreNautix has never received an alert with these identity labels. Common causes: the alert is not routed to a SreNautix ingest source; the labels in the link differ from the labels the alert source sends (the identity labels used for the fingerprint are listed below).
alerts.because.not_grouped: SreNautix received this alert at {received} ({status}); the incident engine has not placed it in an incident yet. This page opens the incident once it has.
alerts.because.not_visible: The namespace of this alert or of its incident is outside your role bindings. Role bindings come from Git; the users and roles page explains each permission.
alerts.because.self_alert: The labels carry ingest.self_label. Such alerts describe SreNautix itself; ingest drops them and they never join an incident.
alerts.because.ignored: Watchdog (ingest.watchdog_alertname), InfoInhibitor and severity=none alerts only check the alerting pipeline; ingest drops them and they never join an incident.
